text_block_list.name: Introverted Girl
text_block_list.text: Aaahhh... But I'm really scared!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You'll be fine! You've come all this<n>way to tour the
academy, so why<n>don't you take a good look
around?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Hearing somebody crying, I follow the<n>sound to its
source. There, I find Ines<n>Fujin and Biwa Hayahide
consoling a<n>child.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! Well, this kid's come to<n>tour the
academy, so I was hoping to<n>show her the track,
but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
She got frightened after a scuffle<n>broke out
between two students who<n>were training. It'd be
such a shame<n>to send her home in this state...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! She can't go home like this!<n>Hmm. Maybe
we should just explain<n>what she saw!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...So you see, those two share a<n>synergy that's
very conducive to<n>mutual improvement. What you
witnessed really wasn't a "fight," per<n>se.

text_block_list.name: Introverted Girl
text_block_list.text: B-but they were angry... They werefighting!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You can't force her to understand, somaybe you'd better ease up! Tryexplaining more gently.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
D-don't be afraiiid. Racing is truuuly<n>delightful! ♪ La,
la, laaa. ♪

text_block_list.name: Introverted Girl
text_block_list.text: Waaaah! Now I'm even more scared!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, this isn't working! We've tried<n>so many
things to pique her interest,<n>but she just won't
come anywhere<n>near the track!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. I'm reminded of when my little<n>sister refuses
to eat her vegetables.<n>Although when it comes to
running,<n>my sister is always hot on my heels.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, my sisters are the same. They<n>stick to me
like glue the moment I try<n>to leave for training.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hey, that gives me an idea!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Who's up for some fun at the<n>track? I think
we're free to use that<n>one over there!

text_block_list.name: Introverted Girl
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great! It's incredibly<n>refreshing to go
running on a wide<n>open track... But alas! I think it'll
just<n>be the two of us today!

text_block_list.name: Introverted Girl
text_block_list.text: W-wait up!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Take a looky-look! The staff here<n>work every day
to keep this turf nice<n>and tidy.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And here's where the gentle slope<n>starts. This is
where I run to build my<n>stamina. And then there's
the...

text_block_list.name: Introverted Girl
text_block_list.text: Wait! Pleeease! You're way too fast...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hehe, you'll be just fine! I know youcan catch up!

text_block_list.name: Introverted Girl
text_block_list.text: Ah... Ugh!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And that's where my trainer watches<n>me from!
Apparently, you can see the<n>whole track really well
from there!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Before I know it, the tour has become<n>a full-on
chase. And while Ines Fujin<n>looks to be holding
back, the younger<n>girl seems to be running as fast
as<n>she can.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: All right, time to up the pace!

text_block_list.name: Introverted Girl
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Okay, that concludes the tour! Be sure<n>to take care
on your way home,<n>okay?

text_block_list.name: Introverted Girl
text_block_list.text:
I will... So, um, I had a really fun time<n>running after
you today!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Glad to hear it! Let's play again<n>sometime!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: See ya later, alligator! Hehe.

Do you think she has the potential to be your
underclassman one day?
You really showed your big sister side today!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: See ya later, alligator! Hehe.
choice_data_list:
Do you think she has the potential to be your
underclassman one day?
You really showed your big sister side today!
You really showed your big sister side today!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I think she's got the stuff!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Agreed. I was watching you two from<n>afar, but she
really kept up with you,<n>Ines.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she was chasing after me with<n>this twinkle in
her eyes... I sure she'll<n>be at Tracen again in a few
years'<n>time—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Nope, scratch that. I want to see her<n>at the Twinkle
Series.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And when she's there... I bet we'll<n>be able to put
each other to the test!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin is definitely a great<n>mentor—but at the
same time, there's<n>no mistaking the fierce fighting
spirit<n>in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I didn't do that much. ♪ I just<n>wanted to
show her how fun it is to<n>run together with
someone!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Heya-hey, Hayahide! Let's go for a<n>run—the
track's free for the taking!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hm. I'd be glad to join you, but only<n>after we let
the student council know<n>that the tour is—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yay! Then let's race to the student<n>council office!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...See?! Wouldn't it be a shame to go<n>your whole
life without knowing how<n>wonderful this is?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Even while being kind and sisterly,<n>she embraces
the thrills of running<n>more than anyone... Today, I
got a<n>great glimpse into Ines Fujin's<n>character!
